items.source: To have your results sorted on a particular property, add a sort URL parameter with the name of the property on which you want to sort the results. You can control the direction of the sort by appending a comma (,) to the the property name plus either asc or desc. The following would use the findByNameStartsWith query method defined on the PersonRepository for all Person entities with names starting with the letter “K” and add sort data that orders the results on the name property in descending order:
items.translation: 若要按特定属性对结果进行排序，请添加名为该属性的 `sort` URL 参数。您可以通过在属性名后追加逗号 (,) 以及 asc 或 desc 来控制排序方向。以下示例将使用定义在 PersonRepository 上的 findByNameStartsWith 查询方法，获取所有姓名以字母“K"开头的 Person 实体，并添加排序数据，按 name 属性以降序排列结果：

items.source: Each paged response returns links to the previous and next pages of results based on the current page by using the IANA-defined link relations prev and next. If you are currently at the first page of results, however, no prev link is rendered. For the last page of results, no next link is rendered.
items.translation: 每个分页响应都会基于当前页面返回指向上一页和下一页结果的链接，使用的是 IANA 定义的链接关系prev和next。如果您当前处于结果的第一页，则不会渲染prev链接；对于结果的最后一页，则不会渲染next链接。

items.source: Note that the self and next URIs are, in fact, URI templates. They accept not only size, but also page and sort as optional flags.
items.translation: 请注意，self 和 next URI 实际上是 URI 模板。它们不仅接受 size，还可选地接受 page 和 sort 作为标志。

items.source: The Spring Data REST exporter recognizes the returned Page/Slice and gives you the results in the body of the response, just as it would with a non-paged response, but additional links are added to the resource to represent the previous and next pages of data.
items.translation: Spring Data REST 导出器能够识别返回的 Page/Slice，并将结果放在响应体中，就像处理非分页响应一样；同时，还会在资源中添加额外的链接，以表示上一页和下一页的数据。

items.source: To sort the results by more than one property, keep adding as many sort=PROPERTY parameters as you need. They are added to the Pageable in the order in which they appear in the query string. Results can be sorted by top-level and nested properties. Use property path notation to express a nested sort property. Sorting by linkable associations (that is, links to top-level resources) is not supported.
items.translation: 若要按多个属性对结果进行排序，请根据需要添加尽可能多的 sort=PROPERTY 参数。这些参数会按照它们在查询字符串中出现的顺序添加到 Pageable 中。结果可以按顶层属性和嵌套属性进行排序。请使用属性路径表示法来表达嵌套的排序属性。不支持对可链接关联（即指向顶层资源的链接）进行排序。

items.source: This feature lets you map optional buttons on the screen to these hypermedia controls, letting you implement navigational features for the UI experience without having to hard code the URIs. In fact, the user can be empowered to pick from a list of page sizes, dynamically changing the content served, without having to rewrite the next and `prev controls at the top or bottom.
items.translation: 此功能允许您将屏幕上的可选按钮映射到这些超媒体控件，从而无需硬编码 URI 即可为 UI 体验实现导航功能。事实上，用户可以被赋予从页面大小列表中选择的权力，动态地改变所服务的内容，而无需重写顶部或底部的 `next` 和 `prev` 控件。

items.source: This section documents Spring Data REST’s usage of the Spring Data Repository paging and sorting abstractions. To familiarize yourself with those features, see the Spring Data documentation for the repository implementation you use (such as Spring Data JPA).
items.translation: 本节记录了 Spring Data REST 如何使用 Spring Data Repository 的分页和排序抽象。若要熟悉这些功能，请参阅您所使用的仓库实现的 Spring Data 文档（例如 Spring Data JPA）。

items.source: Rather than return everything from a large result set, Spring Data REST recognizes some URL parameters that influence the page size and the starting page number.
items.translation: Spring Data REST 不会返回大型结果集中的所有内容，而是识别一些影响每页大小和起始页码的 URL 参数。

items.source: As mentioned earlier, the bottom of the HAL document includes a collection of details about the page. This extra information makes it easy for you to configure UI tools like sliders or indicators to reflect the user’s overall position when they view the data. For example, the document in the preceding example shows we are looking at the first page (with page numbers starting at 0).

items.source: 1 The next link now points to yet another page, indicating its relative perspective to the self link. 2 A prev link now appears, giving us a path to the previous page. 3 The current number is now 1 (indicating the second page).
items.translation:
1 next 链接现在指向了另一个页面，表明其相对于 self 链接的相对视角。
2 现在出现了一个 prev 链接，为我们提供了通往上一页的路径。
3 当前数字现在是 1（表示第二页）。

items.source: 1 The self link serves up the whole collection with some options. 2 The next link points to the next page, assuming the same page size. 3 At the bottom is extra data about the page settings, including the size of a page, total elements, total pages, and the page number you are currently viewing.
items.translation: 1 self 链接提供整个集合及其一些选项。 2 next 链接指向下一页，前提是保持相同的页面大小。 3 底部包含关于页面设置的额外数据，包括页面大小、总元素数、总页数以及您当前查看的页码。
